title: duplicate treatments
symptom: xDrip+ is adding two entries to careportal, one listed as xdrip and one listed as blank. One is of the type of entry it is (e.g. meal bolus) and one is just a note.
cause: The issue was a bug that was already fixed in a newer version.
fix: Switch the update channel to Alpha in the Update Settings section and apply the offered update.
evidence_quote: Okay I think this may be a bug already fixed, can you switch the update channel to Alpha in the Update Settings section and apply the offered update and let me know if that resolves the issue?
